name: Ganyu
notes: Both sources agree on 4pc Blizzard Strayer for Freeze, a Cryo DMG goblet and CRIT circlet, and on Normal Attack >= Burst > Skill; they add Marechaussee Hunter (melt/general) and Unfinished Reverie (Melt, Game8's best for Melt). Sands: ATK% for Freeze, EM for Melt (both). Damage talent: her Frostflake Arrow is charged-attack damage; the kit lines show it on the elemental curve (1.8x at level 10), not the physical one, and the kit's 'check' line (Skill's Ice Lotus) is ATK-based and minor. Neither source gives CRIT or ATK goals; ER 115 is the top of KQM's on-field 110-115 at C0 with a Freeze team (off-field she needs 150-160). Partners: Cryo, Anemo and Hydro for Freeze, Pyro for Melt.
